2. C2 — Current-plan attribution versus merely writing a readout. Expected receipt: exact-head job and input/context/output digests, not a comment asserting success. Withdrawal/rollback criterion: reject the candidate if valid bound results are rejected or raw evidence is silently lost. No automatic re-execution or paid retry follows a missing result.
